entries.summary: Fixed three root causes of missing AI execution failure records: (1) Frontend execution-store silently discarded failures when no prior state existed — fixed by creating new failed entries. (2) Server-side createDbRecord and runExecution race condition — fixed by awaiting createDbRecord. (3) persistToDb had no retry — added single retry with 1s delay. (4) UI error section was hidden on immediate POST failure — added failed status to render condition.

metadata.plan_id: AI 执行任务失败记录修复

lessons_learned: When changing a sync function to async, always check all callers — TypeScript catches this via tsc but the diff tool may not flag it as a contract change
Tree-sitter syntax_check gives false positives on TSX files — always cross-reference with tsc build_check for TypeScript projects
Fire-and-forget patterns hide race conditions — when two async operations depend on ordering, always await the prerequisite
UI conditional rendering can hide error states — always check that error conditions are included in visibility conditions
ESLint 9 config migration issue (.eslintrc.json vs eslint.config.js) is a project-level concern, not a per-task issue

entries.summary: Phase 1 完成了执行状态模型从 3 状态（running/completed/failed）到 7 状态（pending/running/completed/failed/cancelled/timed_out/interrupted）的完整扩展。实现了 FSM 状态转换验证、3-way abort reason 检测（user_cancel/timeout/其他）、服务重启 interrupted 清理、SSE 驱动的前端状态同步（不再前端直接 failExecution），以及 7 种状态的独特图标和文案 UI。

metadata.plan_id: AI 执行生命周期监控

top_rejection_reasons: Task 1.6: 输出区域未为新终端状态显示标签和可见性条件未扩展
lessons_learned: Task 1.3 被误标为 completed 但代码未实现 — checkpoint restore 可能回滚代码但不清除 gate evidence，需要验证代码实际状态
AbortController.abort(reason) + signal.reason 是区分不同 abort 来源的标准 Web API 方式，适用于 Node.js 17.2+
UI 变更需要关注所有终端状态的输出区域可见性和状态标签，不只是新增的图标
tree-sitter syntax_check 对 TSX 文件有大量误报，必须用 tsc 交叉验证
ESLint 9 配置问题是项目级别的（缺少 eslint.config.js），不影响代码质量检查

entries.summary: Phase 1 完成了故事地图拖拽视觉反馈改进：移除 DropInsertLine 横线指示器，新增 GhostNode 半透明幽灵卡片预览，在 nodesWithIndicators useMemo 中实现拖拽时实时位置预计算（同列重排+跨列移动），并添加 CSS transition 动画使卡片让位平滑过渡。
lessons_learned: test_engineer 发现了 sourceJourneyIndex === -1 的防御性边界情况，证明 Stage B 测试门控的价值
CSS transition 应用在 ReactFlow 节点包装器上而非组件内部，需要通过 :not(.dragging) 排除被拖拽节点
syntax_check 对 TSX 文件有大量误报，build_check (tsc) 是更可靠的编译验证
